author: Clijmart
body:
Hey,
after I got promoted to Builder, I got asked a lot of questions...
'Do you want to build a map with me?', was the most asked one.
Because of this, I'm starting a small Map Making Event, where we'll try and create lots of fun maps for the Avicus Network.

Info:
The event will take place on a private server I made for this, it's whitelisted, so message me ingame or on teamspeak for the IP and a whitelist add.
The event will probably take more than a week, but can be extended if we feel like we should.
The server is a plotworld with 200x200 plots, which should be enough. Players can use WorldEdit and VoxelSniper, with limits ofcourse.

The games we will be making maps for are: DTM, DTC and CTW, but if you want to make maps for different gamemodes we can talk about that.

Make sure to help when you feel like doing so, you don't need to be a good builder, just having fun is enough :D

Any questions? Ask them with a reply, or with a message in game.

- Clijmart

replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
I make maps, because I like building and testing how well they play.
I don't mind them being put a Tournament maps or public ones, it doesn't matter for me, but I'm not gonna focus on Tournament maps alone, since I never play those.

If the mapdevs decide to set them as Tournament Maps, fine, but I'm not focusing on building those :P
